obligations.requirement: Every independently admitted real effect has a causal source-command refinement, including out-of-process and environmental effects.
Independent external effect sensor measures every required harm/effect class and supplies a stated residual upper bound on every real transition.
Hold ACK is linearized after new admission closes and all in-flight and pending work is completed or physically fenced.
OS/hardware authority prevents direct writers and other non-cooperative actuator access to the final effect path; challenge independent writers.
Fault injection covers delayed work, power loss, restarts, clock rollback, secondary channels, and third-party/environmental effects.
Source/version/timebase/identities and independently collected scoped measurements are reproducible and all required physical screens pass.
